타일 14개로 시작합니다. 같은 색 연속 숫자 또는 서로 다른 색의 같은: Start with 14 tiles. Make runs of one colour or groups of the same number in different colours, using at least three tiles. Your initial meld must total 30 points from your rack. Afterwards you may rearrange the table; every group must remain valid. Jokers replace numbers and cost 30 points if left. Empty your rack to win. Move selected tiles to a new group, existing group or rack. This digital version allows free joker rearrangement.

The digital balance model uses support and centre of mass rather than real wood friction. In solo mode, try to improve your number of successful placements.
차례대로 카드를 한 장씩 뒤집으세요. 보이는 같은 과일이 정확히 5개이면: Take turns flipping one card. Ring when exactly five of the same fruit are visible. The first correct bell collects the face-up piles. A wrong bell gives one card to each opponent; with only two players left, a wrong bell loses. Reaction time is measured using the first processed touch.
말을 선택한 뒤 이동할 칸을 누르세요. 왕이 공격받는 수는 둘 수 없습니: Select a piece, then its destination. You cannot leave your king in check. Castling, en passant and promotion are supported. Checkmate wins; stalemate draws. Repetition, the fifty-move rule and insufficient material are automatic draws. The AI is for practice.

With forbidden moves enabled, black cannot make overlines, double threes or double fours, and wins with exactly five. Black starts in the centre. Tournament opening procedures are not used.
